title: You'll Never Find Me
description: On a stormy night, a mysterious woman asks for shelter at Patrick's mobile home. Their anxiety and mutual mistrust grow as the night unfolds, causing fear and paranoia to engulf the small RV.

title: The Night
description: A couple become trapped inside a hotel with their demons -- real and imagined -- until they can confront the secrets of their marriage.

title: Relic
description: A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

title: Revenge
description: A shocking act leaves a woman brutalized and left for dead by three sleazy men. Unfortunately for her assailants, she survives and soon begins a relentless quest for bloody revenge.

title: Almost Human
description: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

description: Some friends are attacked by a sniper after a tire blowout leaves them stranded.

description: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move into their dream home.
